49.original: At first I didn't know what to make of Zero, but her frankness speaks to me. I like her!

50.original: My thanks again for agreeing to help.

52.original: We have yet to deliver a share of supplies to Tertium, and I would appreciate it if one of you could assist us with the task today.

54.original: Well, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. It looks like you're with me, then.

55.original: Voidsent sightings have been increasing by the day, which is why I had a mind to go out and patrol the Eblan Rime. Shall we?

56.original: Voidsent were spotted here not long ago. Considering the proximity to Camp Broken Glass, everyone is understandably concerned.

57.original: But hopefully not for much longer. You follow this road eastward, and I'll have a look to the north. If you should encounter any voidsent, I won't begrudge you for dispatching them without me.

59.original: You survey your surroundings, but do not spy any errant voidsent...
